title: Explicitly completed or cancelled cards can remain labelled scheduled
status: implemented and tested; draft PR #190 awaiting review and integration
evidence: Upcoming listing filtered only by sport, promotion, query and date. A future/recent event with status completed rendered as scheduled; regression failed before fix and passed after.
rootCause: Date grace period did not consult explicit terminal event status.
impact: Terminal cards within the grace period could be shown as upcoming. No claim of a currently affected production event.
remediation: Exclude explicit completed/cancelled event states before date filtering; preserve recent unconfirmed cards.
risks: Only explicit terminal states excluded; no completion inferred from date or missing data.
dependenciesAndConflicts: assets/upcoming-cards.js has no overlap with inspected open research PRs; no collector or stored record changes.
verificationRequired: Synthetic completed/cancelled/recent-unconfirmed tests and existing upcoming UI/merge/timezone/poster regression suites pass. Approval required before production rollout.

evidence: tests/test-results-ui.cjs loses focus on selecting rendered prelims before fix and passes after. Live browser Fights navigation timed out; no live reproduction claimed.
